answer_1.quote: Transformer based models have been proven to be very effective in building the state-of-the-art Neural Machine Translation (NMT) systems via neural networks and attention mechanism.
answer_1.outputs: translated text outputs in target language

answer_2.quote: We measure the case-insensitive/case-sensitive BLEU scores using multibleu.perl with the statistical significance test for NIST Zh-En and WMT'14 En-De, respectively. For WMT'18 Zh-En, we use case sensitive BLEU scores calculated by Moses mteval-v13a.pl script.
